constructor-arg.value: SELECT TIPO AS ACT_ID, NOMBRE AS DESC_ACTIVIDAD FROM PUBLIC.TACTIV WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE NOMBRE ILIKE ? END ORDER BY NOMBRE ASC

SELECT GI.ID AS GIR_ID, GI.DESCRIPCION AS DESC_GIRO, GI.CLAVE_CNBV, GI.CLAVE_FND, AC.TIPO AS ACT_ID, AC.NOMBRE AS DESC_ACTIVIDAD FROM PUBLIC.CAT_GIROS GI LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.TACTIV AC ON AC.TIPO = GI.ACTIVIDAD WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE AC.NOMBRE ILIKE ? END AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE GI.DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY GI.DESCRIPCION ASC
SELECT CLAVE AS DES_ID, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_DESTINO, CLAVE_CNBV FROM PUBLIC.DESTINO WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC
SELECT CLAVE AS OCU_ID, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_OCUPACION FROM PUBLIC.OCUPACIONES WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC

SELECT LO.CLAVE AS LOC_ID, LO.DESCRIPCION AS DESC_LOCALIDAD, LO.CATMPIO_ID AS MPIO_ID, LO.CLAVE_CNBV AS LOC_CLAVE_CNBV, MP.DESCRIPCION AS DES_MUNICIPIO, MP.ESTADO_ID AS EST_ID, ES.NOMBRE AS DESC_ESTADO, ES.CLAVE_NAFIN AS NAFIN_ID, ES.NOMBRE_MINUS AS DESC_ESTADO_NAFIN, ES.CLAVE_CNBV AS EST_CLAVE_CNVB FROM PUBLIC.LOCALIDADES LO LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.CATMPIO MP ON MP.CMPIOMPIO = LO.CATMPIO_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.ESTATAL ES ON ES.CLAVE = MP.ESTADO_ID WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE LO.DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY ES.NOMBRE ASC, MP.DESCRIPCION ASC, LO.DESCRIPCION ASC

SELECT CO.CLAVE AS COL_ID, CO.NOMBRE AS DESC_COLONIA, LO.CLAVE_CNBV AS COL_CLAVE_CNBV, LO.CLAVE AS LOC_ID, LO.DESCRIPCION AS DESC_LOCALIDAD, LO.CLAVE_CNBV AS LOC_CLAVE_CNBV, LO.CATMPIO_ID AS MPIO_ID, MP.DESCRIPCION AS DES_MUNICIPIO, MP.ESTADO_ID AS EST_ID, ES.NOMBRE AS DESC_ESTADO, ES.CLAVE_NAFIN AS NAFIN_ID, ES.NOMBRE_MINUS AS DESC_ESTADO_NAFIN, ES.CLAVE_CNBV AS EST_CLAVE_CNVB FROM PUBLIC.COLONIA CO LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.LOCALIDADES LO ON LO.CLAVE = CO.LOCALIDAD_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.CATMPIO MP ON MP.CMPIOMPIO = LO.CATMPIO_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.ESTATAL ES ON ES.CLAVE = MP.ESTADO_ID WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE CO.NOMBRE ILIKE ? END ORDER BY ES.NOMBRE ASC, MP.DESCRIPCION ASC, LO.DESCRIPCION ASC, CO.NOMBRE ASC

SELECT ID AS IDENT_ID, CLAVE AS CVE_IDENT, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_IDENTIFICADOR FROM PUBLIC.CAT_IDENTIFICADORES WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC

SELECT ID AS TIPO_IDEN_ID, CLAVE AS CVE_TIPO_IDENT, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_TIPO_IDENTIFICADOR FROM PUBLIC.TIPO_IDENTIFICACION WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC
SELECT CAT_DOMICILIO_ID AS DOM_ID, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_DOMICILIO, ABREVIACION FROM CAT_DOMICILIOS WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC
SELECT CLAVE AS EST_ID, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_ESTUDIOS FROM CAT_ESTUDIOS WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC
SELECT CLAVE AS CIV_ID, NOMBRE AS DESC_ESTADO_CIVIL, PATMIR FROM EDOCIVIL WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE NOMBRE ILIKE ? END ORDER BY NOMBRE ASC
SELECT ID AS PAIS_ID, DESCRIPCION AS DESC_PAIS FROM PAISES WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY DESCRIPCION ASC

SELECT NA.CLAVE AS NAC_ID, NA.DESCRIPCION AS DES_NACIONALIDAD, NA.CLAVE_CNBV, NA.ID_PAIS AS PAIS_ID, PA.DESCRIPCION AS DESC_PAIS,NA.CVE_RENAPO, NA.ABREVIACION FROM NACIONALIDADES NA LEFT JOIN PAISES PA ON PA.ID = NA.ID_PAIS WHERE TRUE AND CASE WHEN TRUE = ? THEN TRUE ELSE NA.DESCRIPCION ILIKE ? END ORDER BY NA.DESCRIPCION ASC

SELECT CO.CP AS CODIGO_POSTAL, CO.ID AS COL_ID, CO.DESCRIPCION AS DESC_COLONIA, LO.ID AS LOC_ID, LO.DESCRIPCION AS DESC_LOCALIDAD, LO.MUNICIPIO_ID AS MPIO_ID, MP.DESCRIPCION AS DES_MUNICIPIO, MP.ESTADO_ID AS EST_ID, ES.NOMBRE AS DESC_ESTADO FROM PUBLIC.colonia_sepomex CO LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.localidad_sepomex LO ON LO.ID = CO.LOCALIDAD_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.municipio_sepomex MP ON MP.ID = LO.MUNICIPIO_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.ESTATAL ES ON ES.CLAVE = MP.ESTADO_ID WHERE CO.CP = ? ORDER BY ES.NOMBRE ASC, MP.DESCRIPCION ASC, LO.DESCRIPCION ASC, CO.DESCRIPCION ASC
select x.id from( select o.clave as id from ocupaciones o where o.clave = ? union select c.id from cat_giros c where c.id = ?) as x
select e.clave from estatal e where e.clave = ?
select n.clave from nacionalidades n where n.clave = ?
select p.id from paises p where p.id = ?
select ti.id from tipo_identificacion ti where ti.id = ?
select ts.tipo_sociedad_id from tipos_sociedades ts where ts.tipo_sociedad_id = ?
select c.id from colonia_sepomex c where (c.id = ? or c.cp = ?)
